```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    units_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    units_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    orders_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    orders_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)

    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if rev_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if rev_ly:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", num((rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(units_tw), "sum(Units_TW)")
    if units_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", num((units_tw - units_lw) / units_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(orders_tw), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if orders_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", num((orders_tw - orders_lw) / orders_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).copy()

    # Top 5 entities by revenue this week
    top = d.sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for this product")
    if len(top):
        r0 = top.iloc[0]
        share0 = r0["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r0.get("Share_Pct")) else (
            r0["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else np.nan)
        add(r0["Entity"], "share", "TW", num(share0, 1), "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        add(r0["Entity"], "rank", "TW", num(r0["Rank"], 0), "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    if rev_tw:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # Biggest absolute WoW movers
    d["rev_delta"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    dd = d.dropna(subset=["rev_delta"])
    for _, r in dd.sort_values("rev_delta", ascending=False).head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["rev_delta"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    for _, r in dd.sort_values("rev_delta").head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["rev_delta"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # Biggest WoW percent movers among meaningful revenue bases
    base = d[(d["Revenue_LW"].notna()) & (d["Revenue_LW"] > 0) & (d["WoW_Pct"].notna())]
    if len(base):
        thr = base["Revenue_LW"].quantile(0.75)
        big = base[base["Revenue_LW"] >= thr]
        for _, r in big.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
        for _, r in big.sort_values("WoW_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # Biggest YoY movers
    y = d[(d["Revenue_LY"].notna()) & (d["Revenue_LY"] > 0) & (d["YoY_Pct"].notna())]
    if len(y):
        ythr = y["Revenue_LY"].quantile(0.75)
        yb = y[y["Revenue_LY"] >= ythr]
        for _, r in yb.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["YoY_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
        for _, r in yb.sort_values("YoY_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["YoY_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # Volume leaders
    u = d.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if len(u):
        r = u.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(r["Units_TW"], 0), "max(Units_TW) across products")
    o = d.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
    if len(o):
        r = o.sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "orders", "TW", num(r["Orders_TW"], 0), "max(Orders_TW) across products")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
